_comment: Limits for the hetzner-cloud cloud-init recipe target. Sized for CX22 (Arm Ampere, 4 GB) or CX21 (x86, 4 GB). Schema in deputyctl/src/limits.rs. Note: Hetzner does not give us a custom snapshot — updates are full re-image cycles via cloud-init.

limitations.reason: Hetzner Cloud instances have no audio device; voice features disabled
limitations.unblock: deploy on rpi5 8GB+ or x86_64-mini-pc for voice

limitations.reason: We don't ship a signed Hetzner snapshot; the cloud-init recipe pulls the deputyOS bundle at first boot
limitations.unblock: verify the recipe SHA before applying; recipe tracks docs/03-image-builds.md

limitations.reason: Updates are full re-image cycles (delete + redeploy). Less ergonomic than DO 1-Click.
limitations.unblock: deputyctl update on this target prints a 'redeploy via cloud-init' instruction (M4)

limitations.reason: RAM tier 'standard' (4 GB) below local-LLM threshold
limitations.unblock: scale to CX32 / CCX13 or larger
